risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~80% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (5 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.033), which favours a robust combination.
